title: Guarantee Coverage Rent and How the Tenancy Ended: Security Deposit Account
content:
**Rule.** For a Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan Security Deposit Account, the coverage rent that the guarantee coverage is measured on follows how the tenancy ended. That is shown by the lease's completed last term under the Lease Term Agreement:

- When the completed last term was a **month-to-month conversion**, the coverage rent is the lease's monthly rent, without the month-to-month premium, as recorded on the Apartment Home Lease.
- When the last term **came from a transfer**, the coverage rent is the contracted rent of the transfer term.
- When the last term was a **new lease or a signed renewal**, the coverage rent is the monthly rent at move-in, which is the contracted rent of the lease's first term.

**Records read.** From the Lease Term Agreement: how the lease's completed last term came about, the contracted rent of the transfer term, and the contracted rent of the first term. From the Apartment Home Lease: its monthly rent.

## Condition table

| Completed last term came about as | Coverage rent |
|---|---|
| month-to-month conversion | the lease's monthly rent, without the month-to-month premium |
| transfer | the contracted rent of the transfer term |
| new lease | the contracted rent of the first term |
| signed renewal | the contracted rent of the first term |

## Hypothetical cases

- First term at 1700.00 USD, a renewal at 1790.00 USD as the completed last term: the coverage rent is 1700.00 USD.
- First term at 1700.00 USD, the last term a transfer at 2050.00 USD: the coverage rent is 2050.00 USD.
- First term at 1700.00 USD, the last term a month-to-month conversion, lease monthly rent 1850.00 USD: the coverage rent is 1850.00 USD.
